criteria.text: tj-n7p4.1 is closed only after classify_grounding_output is the pure deterministic decision used by response_policy and the acceptance harness, deterministic repair is isolated behind one named function, all other guard sources remain byte-identical, and the protected 60-output replay is unchanged.

tj-n7p4.2 is closed only after each of the six response guards is declared replacing or removing with one-line reasons; replacing guards prove removed meaning is covered by added text, removing guards raise a flag without editing text, and the protected 60-output replay is unchanged.

tj-n7p4.3 is closed only after the second-vendor repair judge supports approve, correct, and cannot-fix; records flags, answers, and model identity; rejects empty corrections; re-classifies corrections before send; and root-reads every corrected protected reply against the text it replaces.
tj-n7p4.6 is closed only after judge unavailability or rejected correction produces a counted manager handoff that tells the customer, with no fallback path restoring deterministic sentence deletion.

tj-n7p4.4 is closed only after the acceptance harness uses the same triggered repair path as production, journals every repair-judge call against the authorized stage cap, and proves a no-trigger run makes no extra call.

tj-n7p4.5 is closed only after exactly 20 authorized Luna generation calls plus only triggered repair-judge calls are run on the frozen seed-20260810 twenty without a paid scoring reader; the root blind reading reports criticals, trigger and answer counts, fallback counts, cost, and every rewrite comparison.

Each child .1, .2, .3, .6, .4, and .5 has one local main commit and one validated tracked artifact; required Ruff, format, Mypy, full Pytest, process, replay, and reading gates pass; stage readiness and slice closeout pass; corpus text stays outside Git; no push, deploy, live mutation, model configuration change, or real-user message occurs.
